exposure.note: >= 3 canary iron pickaxes made by the kit (`_kit_ironpick` made=1) in the read window AND pre-window ARMED bots (no iron pickaxe above 40, no usable diamond+, from bot.tools) on both arms >= 1. Dry run 10-20 (CANARY_DRYRUN board-a,hive-a,hive-b,placebo-a, 6 h on the base): 13 of 20 canary-arm bots and 53 of 60 control bots armed; 0 kit rows (base). A 20-bot draw with ~14 armed bots visiting town is expected to make 3 by +180.

own_lines.note: P1: a made=1 kit_ironpick row whose best= after is not a covering pickaxe (the craft claimed, the bag does not show it).

P2: a run drew the pickaxe's iron (drew >= 3, made=0, not aborted, no death in the run), a LATER kit run of the bot ran (the credited retry), and no later row of the bot holds a covering pickaxe. Without a later kit run it is pending (reported).
P3: a town_deposit/deposit row banking an iron pickaxe above 40 uses within 60 min of that bot's made=1 row (the kit's fresh copy banked straight back).
P4: a canary well_dispose row naming a thrown pickaxe (args.items first, then the detail).
P5: a kit_ironpick row that drew iron with iron_seen - drew < keep (the container drawn from kept less than TOWN_IRON_KEEP 4).
P6: a made=1 row whose best= BEFORE already covered (an iron pickaxe above 40 or a usable diamond+) -- a craft the rule forbids. Craft frequency is reported only.
ARMS: a control _kit_ironpick or _toolkit_ironpick_mode row after the deploy. BLOCKS KEEP.
LIVENESS (mechanism): >= 1 canary kit_ironpick row. BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE).
POSITIVE CONTROL: control bots ARMED at their last row >= 1 and control rows carrying bot.tools >= 1 (dry run: 53 armed, 173,548 rows). BLOCKS KEEP.
toolkit-01's K1 on the canary arm (a kit run that ended with no usable pickaxe). toolkitread's rows_control line is NOT used: the toolkit is fleet-wide.
K2 on the canary arm: a clearly usable tool missing after a kit run (the worn iron copy must stay).
K4 on the canary arm (a claimed iron_pickaxe craft the after= tags do not show).

primary.note: REPORTED: bots whose last row holds a covering pickaxe (iron > 40 or a usable diamond+) per bot seen, DiD (should RISE); kit pickaxes made per canary bot-h; double trips (a withdraw_pick order taking a pickaxe within 15 min of a made=1 row; legitimate when the kit was on cooldown); P2 pending; craft frequency.

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor (OWNER 2026-09-11) and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control (immobiledid). The kit run is the toolkit-03 town search (inside town, <= 12 container visits) drawing up to 7 ingots from ONE container that keeps 4. change_rows: `kit_ironpick` (one per kit run whose needs include the pickaxe; timestamp = the run's end, duration = the run); the baseline cannot write it.

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions. The change edits nothing in the world (it takes town iron the toolkit already draws from). Rollback without a canary: TOOLKIT_IRONPICK=off.
